test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: After how many years (approximately) of debate, the Constitution of India was signed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**3 years**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Constituent Assembly of India was formed in 1946 to draft the Constitution of India.
 
• The drafting process was led by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, who is often referred to as the "Father of the Indian Constitution."
 
• The Assembly took approximately 3 years to debate and finalize the Constitution.
 
• The Constitution was finally adopted on 26th November 1949 and came into effect on 26th January 1950.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Constituent Assembly:**

 
 
• The Constituent Assembly was a body of elected representatives tasked with drafting the Constitution of India.
 
• It was formed in 1946 following the Cabinet Mission Plan.
 
• The Assembly had 299 members representing various regions and communities of India.
 
 
 
• **Dr. B.R. Ambedkar:**
 
 
• Dr. Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar was an Indian jurist, economist, and social reformer.
 
• He was the Chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Constituent Assembly.
 
• He played a crucial role in framing the Indian Constitution and advocating for social justice.
 
 
 
• **Adoption and Enactment:**
 
 
• The Constitution was adopted on 26th November 1949.
 
• It came into effect on 26th January 1950, which is celebrated as Republic Day in India.
 
• The date 26th January was chosen to honor the declaration of Purna Swaraj (complete independence) by the Indian National Congress in 1930.
